text:
Clara Nguyen: dropping a tiny, copy/pasteable "quick-win" prefill + feedback play for mid-market accounts showing renewal friction. short and actionable.
Ben Park: perfect. can we include clear thresholds and a one-line email for SAs?
Olivia Reed: yup heres a compact customer checklist (aim for a single-paragraph note):```Customer-facing quick-win prefill & monitoring checklist
1) Summary metrics to share: 72h p95 latency, 24h token delta, error %. flag if p95 > 700ms or errors > 0.5%.
2) Minimal prefill (customer action): run top 3 prompts with prefill_tokens=1200, 8s spacing, 3 repeats each to hydrate KV cache.
3) Server recommendations: batch_window=25-60ms, max_concurrency_per_user=1-2 during ramp, request_timeout=6s.
4) Streaming fallback: if stream_gap_ms p90 > 120ms or >8% of requests, fail to single-response to avoid UI fragmentation.
5) Observability keys to include in handoff: "redwood.request_id", "redwood.model.variant", "redwood.cache.hit_rate", "redwood.latency.p95", "redwood.stream.gap_ms". paste values or screenshot.
6) Renewal pulse (2 quick Qs): A) How useful was the assistant today? (1-7) B) Any accuracy regressions? (yes/no + 1-line) -> if usefulness <=3, open a 30m triage.```
Marta Gomez: adding a tiny prefill curl for eng (use lower concurrency):```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill-run 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_XYZ","model":"prod-1","samples":[{"prompt":"<top_prompt_1>","tokens":1200},{"prompt":"<top_prompt_2>","tokens":1200}],"spacing_seconds":8}'
```Note: run <=2 concurrent clients to avoid quota spikes.
Ben Park: can we provide a tiny healthcheck customers can run to confirm cache seeding? keeps handoffs clean.
Olivia Reed: simple python healthcheck snippet:```python
# run after prefill completes
def cache_seeded(metrics_client):
    m = metrics_client.query("redwood.cache.hit_rate", window="1h")
    return getattr(m, 'p95', 0) >= 0.65
```If false, suggest one more round of prefill with same prompts.
Clara Nguyen: email snippet for SAs to paste:```Subject: Quick check after warmup
Hi <Name>,
We ran a short warmup of your assistant to improve latency and consistency. Could you please reply with: 1) Usefulness today (1-7): ____ 2) Any accuracy regressions? (yes/no + short note).
If usefulness <=3 well schedule a 30m triage with engineering. Thanks,
<SA name>
```
Marta Gomez: renewal triage heuristic for CSMs (quick): High risk = usage drop > 40% OR usefulness <=3 OR unresolved quality regression in last 7d -> escalate to eng+CS within 72h. Medium = 15-40% drop OR p95 600-700ms -> targeted prefill + 7d monitor. Low = stable usage and usefulness >=5 -> normal cadence.
Ben Park: wording note: change "fail to single-response" to "fallback to single-response mode" in the customer checklist.
Clara Nguyen: updated. next steps: I'll publish as /repos/cs/runbooks/quick-win-prefill-play.md and post a one-liner in #account-health. tagging @Olivia @Marta for review.
